kind: Source-only numerical method audit; no full CFD equivalence or speed test
notation: r=b−Ax; xref=global arithmetic mean(x); vector absolute values summed globally
stopping_controls: Explicit minIter0/adaptMinIterfalse/evalFrequency1 avoid adaptive skipping of norm checks; p tolerance1e−7,relTol.05,pFinal relTol0.
mandatory_full_cfd_checks: Actual CUDA library link and real CUDA-buffer MPI gather/scatter must pass first.
Execution agent alone launches a bounded new CFD benchmark; never edit a production case.
Compare against the best existing CPU method rerun from identical actual mesh and frozen initial0.6 U,p under the same host load.
Keep all physical inputs, actuator model, losses, time stepping, U solver, mesh and output windows unchanged.
Check pressure convergence, continuity, fields, controller/lift and power agreement; record GPU ownership/host staging and process timing.

Check the anchored pressure operator is SPD after scaling and the actual V-cycle uses transpose restriction/prolongation, matching pre/post smoothing, and positive coarse Jacobi polynomial; CG requires a fixed SPD preconditioner.
Audit globally reduced interface matvecs and OpenFOAM-equivalent residual normalization. Matching tolerance numbers alone is insufficient.
Record a distinct numerical-method signature for CUDA/AMG/communicator settings rather than presenting this as identical CPU numerics.
Include decomposition, first matrix setup and transfer overhead in end-to-end elapsed time; also report steady solver timing separately if available.
No production adoption or claimed speedup until the full CFD correctness and timing comparison passes.
independent_review: CG requires the actually anchored SPD pressure operator and a fixed SPD preconditioner. Galerkin restriction/prolongation, adjoint pre/post smoothing and the Jacobi polynomial must be checked; equal tolerance numbers alone do not prove equivalence.

experimental_backend_configuration.fp: double; half/bfloat16/mixed precision disabled; no fast-math; NVCC standard FMA behavior
